Public REST API for NeuraTalk — real-time translated voice/video calling, transcripts, and webhook signature verification.

Authentication uses an opaque Bearer session token (`sess_<64 hex chars>`), not a JWT — it cannot be decoded locally and must be sent to the server on every request. Sessions are valid for 24 hours from issuance and are automatically extended by 24 hours on every authenticated request (sliding expiration). There is no separate refresh-token endpoint.

There is currently no URL or header-based API versioning on the server (all routes are flat `/api/...`). This spec is versioned at the package level (SDK releases), not the URL level — a future breaking server change would require a new spec/SDK major version, not a new URL prefix.
